cardOverview.overviewText: A Nexxt card featuring EMI-on-swipe functionality, cashback on transactions, and rewards for digitally savvy users seeking flexible payments.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: B1G1 offer on booking movie tickets via BookMyShow, with a maximum of 2 free discounts monthly, and complimentary tickets capped at ₹200 each.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.
